column2: She put an arm around her crying friend and tried to console her.
column3: 她摟著哭泣的朋友，試著安慰她。
column4: console a grieving friend (安慰悲傷的朋友)
column5: con 一起 + sole 像「孤單」：不讓你一個人孤單，就是安慰

column2: Waste from the factory contaminated the river and killed many fish.
column3: 工廠的廢棄物污染了河川，也害死許多魚。
column4: contaminate the water supply (污染供水)
column5: con 一起 + tamin 像「太民」：髒東西跟水混在一起就污染了

column2: The jury convicted the man after seeing the video evidence.
column3: 陪審團看了影像證據後，判那名男子有罪。
column4: convict a suspect of fraud (判嫌犯詐欺罪)
column5: con 完全 + vict 打敗：把你完全打敗，法庭上就是判你有罪

column2: My uncle counseled me to save part of every paycheck.
column3: 叔叔勸我每次領薪水都要存一部分。
column4: counsel patience (勸人要有耐心)
column5: counsel 像「康蘇」：找人諮商拿建議，聽他的忠告

column2: The old wooden stairs creaked every time someone stepped on them.
column3: 每次有人踩上去，那座老木階梯就咯吱作響。
column4: creak under weight (承重時咯吱響)
column5: creak 唸起來像「克里克」：舊門開關時發出的聲音

column2: He was caught cribbing answers from the student sitting next to him.
column3: 他被抓到抄襲隔壁同學的答案。
column4: crib answers from a classmate (抄同學的答案)
column5: crib 本是嬰兒床；偷偷靠過去「睡」別人答案就是作弊

column2: The cat crouched behind the bush, watching the birds closely.
column3: 貓蹲伏在灌木叢後面，緊盯著那些鳥。
column4: crouch behind a wall (蹲在牆後)
column5: crouch 像「扣吃」：蹲低身子好像要扣住東西吃

column2: Dry leaves crunched under our boots as we walked through the forest.
column3: 我們穿過森林時，乾枯的落葉在靴子底下嘎吱作響。
column4: crunch on an apple (嘎吱咬蘋果)
column5: crunch 的聲音就像在咬脆餅乾：克朗奇！

column2: Grandma curries chicken with potatoes every Sunday evening.
column3: 奶奶每個星期天晚上都會用咖喱燒馬鈴薯雞肉。
column4: curry chicken with rice (咖喱雞肉配飯)
column5: curry 就是咖喱；梳馬毛的 curry 是同一個拼法，注意看句子

column2: A small lizard darted across the kitchen floor and vanished under the fridge.
column3: 一隻小蜥蜴飛快竄過廚房地板，消失在冰箱底下。
column4: dart across the road (飛奔穿越馬路)
column5: dart 像「打特」：像飛鏢射出去一樣，一衝而過

column2: The fireworks dazzled the children, who watched with wide eyes.
column3: 煙火讓孩子們看得眼花撩亂，眼睛睜得好大。
column4: dazzle the audience (使觀眾驚豔)
column5: dazzle 像「大走」：強光一閃，眼睛被閃得大轉

column2: If you never brush your teeth, they will slowly decay.
column3: 如果你從不刷牙，牙齒會慢慢蛀壞。
column4: teeth begin to decay (牙齒開始蛀壞)
column5: decay 像「地K」：東西掉到地上不撿就爛掉

column2: After months without work, he began to despair of ever finding a job.
column3: 失業好幾個月後，他開始對找到工作感到絕望。
column4: despair of success (對成功絕望)
column5: de 離開 + spair 像 spare 希望：希望離開了就是絕望

column2: Good teachers never despise a student for asking a simple question.
column3: 好老師絕不會因為學生問簡單的問題就瞧不起他。
column4: despise liars (鄙視說謊者)
column5: de 往下 + spise 像 spy 看：往下看人就是看不起

column2: The hungry boys devoured three pizzas in ten minutes.
column3: 餓壞的男孩們十分鐘就把三個披薩吃得精光。
column4: devour a meal (狼吞虎嚥吃完一餐)
column5: de 加強 + vour 像 vow-er：嘴巴大開把食物整個吞下

column2: She discarded the old magazines and made room on the shelf.
column3: 她把舊雜誌丟掉，在書架上騰出空間。
column4: discard old clothes (丟棄舊衣服)
column5: dis 去掉 + card 卡片：把用不到的牌丟掉

column2: Please dispose of your batteries at the special recycling box.
column3: 請把電池丟到專用的回收箱處理。
column4: dispose of waste (處理廢棄物)
column5: dis 分開 + pose 放：把東西放到別處去處置

column2: The news of the earthquake deeply distressed everyone in the village.
column3: 地震的消息讓村裡每個人都深感痛心。
column4: deeply distress someone (使某人極度苦惱)
column5: dis 分開 + stress 壓力：壓力撕開心情，就是使人苦惱

column2: The nurse documented every change in the patient's condition on the chart.
column3: 護理師把病人狀況的每個變化都記錄在病歷表上。
column4: document the changes (用文件記錄變化)
column5: document 是文件；動詞就是把事情寫成紀錄證明

column2: He draped a blanket over the sofa to hide the stains.
column3: 他在沙發上披了一條毯子來遮住污漬。
column4: drape a cloth over (把布披在上面)
column5: drape 像「抓皮」：隨手把布一披，軟軟垂下來

column2: The giant oak tree dwarfs the little house beside it.
column3: 那棵巨大的橡樹讓旁邊的小房子顯得很矮小。
column4: dwarf the building (使建築顯得矮小)
column5: dwarf 是小矮人；動詞就是讓別人看起來像小矮人

column2: My grandparents dwell in a quiet village near the mountains.
column3: 我的祖父母住在靠近山區的一個寧靜村莊。
column4: dwell in a village (居住在村莊)
column5: dwell 像「兜爾」：兜在一個地方不走，就是住下來

column2: The new bridge will elevate the small town into a popular tourist spot.
column3: 這座新橋會把小鎮提升為熱門的觀光景點。
column4: elevate the status (提升地位)
column5: e 向外 + lev 輕、抬：把東西抬起來往上升

column2: The students endeavor to finish the project before the deadline.
column3: 學生們努力要在截止日前完成專題。
column4: endeavor to succeed (努力成功)
column5: 像「因地發」：在地上拼命努力，就會發達

column2: Parents must enroll their children at the school before September.
column3: 家長必須在九月之前幫孩子到學校註冊。
column4: enroll in a course (報名課程)
column5: en 放入 + roll 名冊：把名字放進點名冊

column2: Seat belts help ensure that passengers stay safe in a crash.
column3: 安全帶有助於確保乘客在車禍中的安全。
column4: ensure your safety (確保你的安全)
column5: en 使 + sure 確定：讓事情確定沒問題

column2: This ticket entitles you to a free drink at the snack bar.
column3: 這張票讓你有資格在點心吧免費領一杯飲料。
column4: entitle you to a discount (讓你有資格享折扣)
column5: en 給予 + title 頭銜：給你頭銜，就是給你資格

column2: Many people wrongly equate being rich with being happy.
column3: 許多人錯誤地把有錢和快樂畫上等號。
column4: equate wealth with happiness (把財富等同快樂)
column5: equ 相等 + ate 使：讓兩邊變得一樣，劃上等號

column2: The volcano erupted without warning and covered the town with ash.
column3: 火山毫無預警地爆發，把小鎮蓋滿了火山灰。
column4: a volcano erupts (火山爆發)
column5: e 向外 + rupt 破裂：往外破開就是噴發

column2: Two police officers escorted the famous singer through the crowd.
column3: 兩名警察護送那位知名歌手穿過人群。
column4: escort a visitor (陪同訪客)
column5: escort 像「A 水車」：貴賓旁邊一路有人護著走

column2: Everyone in town esteems Dr. Lin for her kindness and honesty.
column3: 鎮上人人都敬重林醫師的善良與誠實。
column4: highly esteem someone (十分敬重某人)
column5: esteem 像「A 死天」：尊重到願意把某人當天一樣看

column2: The cost of the trip exceeded what we had planned to spend.
column3: 這趟旅行的花費超過我們原本預計的支出。
column4: exceed the limit (超出限制)
column5: ex 向外 + ceed 走：走到界線外面，就是超過

column2: Mia excels at math and often helps her classmates with homework.
column3: 米雅的數學很出色，常常幫同學做作業。
column4: excel at math (數學很突出)
column5: ex 向外 + cel 高：頭抬得比別人高，表現突出

column2: Look at that rainbow! the little girl exclaimed.
column3: 小女孩驚呼：「你們看那道彩虹！」
column4: exclaim in surprise (驚訝地大叫)
column5: ex 向外 + claim 喊：大聲往外喊出來

column2: The club excluded him from the team because he missed every practice.
column3: 因為他缺席每一次練習，社團把他排除在球隊之外。
column4: exclude someone from a group (把某人排除在團體外)
column5: ex 向外 + clude 關：把人關在門外

column2: The king exiled his rival to a distant island.
column3: 國王把他的對手放逐到遙遠的島上。
column4: exile a leader (放逐領袖)
column5: exile 像「A 色兒」：被趕離家園，色沒了、人也沒了

column2: Her voice faltered when she saw the whole class staring at her.
column3: 當她看到全班都盯著她時，聲音開始發抖結巴。
column4: voice falters (聲音顫抖遲疑)
column5: falter 像「FALL 脫」：腳或話一下子掉鏈子

column2: Space stories have always fascinated my little brother.
column3: 太空故事一直讓我弟弟著迷。
column4: fascinate young readers (吸引年輕讀者)
column5: fascinate 像「法西內」：看得入神，整個人被吸進去

column2: A long day of hiking in the heat fatigued the whole group.
column3: 在高溫下健行一整天，讓整個團隊筋疲力盡。
column4: fatigue the muscles (使肌肉疲勞)
column5: fatigue 像「肥提哥」：肥提哥跑太久，累垮了

column2: Dad likes to fiddle with the radio until the music sounds clear.
column3: 爸爸喜歡亂調收音機，直到音樂聽起來清楚為止。
column4: fiddle with a radio (亂弄收音機)
column5: fiddle 本是小提琴；手指亂撥弄像在拉琴，就是胡亂擺弄
